payload.claim: Ola receives about 80,000 service complaints per month (2024 report)
payload.quote: Insiders familiar with the matter revealed that the Bengaluru-based company receives an average of 80,000 service complaints per month, overwhelming its existing service centers.

payload.claim: Ola customers reported 30-45 day repair waits
payload.quote: Many customers reported waiting anywhere from 30 to 45 days for repairs, and several have taken to social media, particularly X (formerly Twitter), to air their grievances.

payload.claim: Bajaj and TVS kept stable sales while Ola's fell (2024)
payload.quote: Meanwhile, competitors like Bajaj Auto Ltd and TVS Motor Company Ltd have maintained stable sales, continuing their upward trend in the electric scooter market.
Since its establishment, Ola Electric has sold more than 680,000 scooters, and it currently operates 430 service centers across India, according to its official website.

payload.claim: Ola announced plan for 1,000 service centres by Dec 2024
payload.quote: Ola Electric will expand its service network to 1,000 centers nationwide by December 2024 ensuring that customers receive timely assistance regardless of their location.

payload.claim: Ather 450X Eco mode usable even below 10 percent battery
payload.quote: In the case of the Ather 450X, Eco mode is quite usable even when the battery percentage falls below 10 percent.

payload.claim: Ather 450X is the best handling scooter of the four
payload.quote: The Ather 450X is hands down the best handling scooter in this quartet.

payload.claim: Ather is least comfortable, cramped for riders over 5ft 10in
payload.quote: The Ather is the least comfortable of the lot by some margin, with the smallest seat and a high-set floorboard resulting in a cramped riding position, especially for riders taller than 5ft 10in.

payload.claim: TVS iQube is a step above Bajaj Chetak as a comfortable easy city commuter
payload.quote: And in that regard, the TVS is a step above the Bajaj.

payload.claim: Chetak has a firm yet absorbent ride
payload.quote: The Bajaj Chetak has a firm yet nice and absorbent ride, ironing out small undulations and swallowing larger hits as well.

payload.claim: Chetak feels dated and lacks features (2022)
payload.quote: The only scooter that feels like a decade old in this cutting-edge comparison is Bajaj Chetak.

payload.claim: Ather 450X Gen3 claimed range is 146 km
payload.quote: 450X Gen3 only offers a 146km claimed range while the S1 Pro offers 181km.

payload.claim: TVS iQube promised range 140 km with 4.56 kWh battery
payload.quote: Next largest battery is offered by TVS iQube with a 4.56 kWh with a promised range of 140km and then comes S1 Pro with 3.9 kWh.

payload.claim: iQube bigger battery variants give decent range for daily use
payload.quote: The bigger battery pack variants offer decent range for daily use

payload.claim: Ampere claims 420+ service points incl. Bangalore
payload.quote: Service Reach: 420+ service points across India, including strong Bangalore coverage

payload.claim: Real range in Bangalore traffic runs well below IDC
payload.quote: Real-world range in Bangalore traffic runs well below that due to slow speeds, frequent stops, and quick bursts of acceleration to clear junctions.

payload.claim: Ola S1 Pro cuts power on touching brakes
payload.quote: But what’s more annoying is the way in which the S1 Pro cuts the power the moment you touch the brakes.

payload.claim: Reviewers noted suspension failure cases shared online for Ola
payload.quote: The front suspension does feel a bit firm and juddery over bumps, and there’s also a sense of nervousness that arises every time you hit a big pothole after those few cases of suspension failure were shared online.

payload.claim: Test was in Mumbai over about 1,000 km in a week, not Bengaluru
payload.quote: We rode these scooters for around 1,000km across Mumbai over the course of a week and put them through a typical e-scooter rider’s use cases.
